# deposit.now

> deposit.now is the first public x402 API that lets AI agents deposit funds autonomously — 0.01 USDC per call on Base, paid over HTTP 402. No accounts, no API keys, no human sign-up.

Built for machine consumption: any x402 v2 client can read the payment requirements from the HTTP 402 response and pay programmatically. Machine contract: https://deposit.now/openapi.json

## API

- POST https://deposit.now/api/deposit — trigger a deposit. JSON body (optional): {"amount": "100.00", "account": "agent-wallet-123"}
- GET https://deposit.now/api/deposit — deposit info, same payment flow
- Price: 0.01 USDC (10000 atomic units), x402 v2 `exact` scheme
- Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453); testnet (eip155:84532) for local dev
- Unpaid request → HTTP 402 with `Payment-Required` header (base64 JSON: scheme, network, asset, payTo)
- Paid request → 200 JSON with receiptId, receiptUrl, transactionId + payment-response settlement header
- Bazaar discovery extension included in the 402 payload (input/output schemas)

## Pay with JavaScript (@x402/fetch)

    npm install @x402/fetch @x402/core @x402/evm viem

    import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from '@x402/fetch';
    import { x402Client } from '@x402/core/client';
    import { ExactEvmScheme } from '@x402/evm/exact/client';
    import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';

    const signer = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.EVM_PRIVATE_KEY);
    const client = new x402Client();
    client.register('eip155:*', new ExactEvmScheme(signer));
    const fetchWithPayment = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, client);

    const res = await fetchWithPayment('https://deposit.now/api/deposit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: '100.00', account: 'agent-wallet-123' })
    });
    console.log(await res.json());

## Pay with Python (x402[httpx])

    pip install "x402[httpx]" eth-account

    import asyncio, os
    from eth_account import Account
    from x402 import x402Client
    from x402.http.clients import x402HttpxClient
    from x402.mechanisms.evm import EthAccountSigner
    from x402.mechanisms.evm.exact.register import register_exact_evm_client

    async def main():
        client = x402Client()
        account = Account.from_key(os.getenv("EVM_PRIVATE_KEY"))
        register_exact_evm_client(client, EthAccountSigner(account))
        async with x402HttpxClient(client) as http:
            r = await http.post("https://deposit.now/api/deposit",
                                json={"amount": "100.00", "account": "agent-wallet-123"})
            print(await r.aread())

    asyncio.run(main())

## Facts

- Payments verified and settled by an x402 facilitator before the API responds
- Settlement address: 0x3f7a25Dc7307F5662489686e5A457DAD4879F685 (Base)
- Mainnet live on Base (eip155:8453) via CDP facilitator; verifiable receipts at /receipt/<id>
- Contact: form at https://deposit.now
